scenario_summary: Traffic stop shooting of front passenger. Officers in polo shirts with POLICE vests pull over black Mercedes for expired tags. Based on Montes OIS.

claims.claim_text: I was operating the vehicle and Officer Vega was in the passenger seat.
claims.explanation: Consistent with DA letter: Buan driving, Park in passenger seat.

claims.claim_text: Our unit was not equipped with a dashboard camera system.
claims.explanation: DA letter confirms the police unit was not equipped with a video recording system.

claims.claim_text: Both Officer Vega and I were wearing department-issued polo uniform shirts with SAPD identification patches.
claims.explanation: Consistent with DA letter describing SAPD polo uniform shirts.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 1400 hours, I initiated a traffic stop on a black Mercedes Benz.
claims.explanation: DA letter states the stop occurred at 2:00:29 PM. The report says 1400 which matches, but the actual stop was at 2:00 PM, not earlier.

claims.claim_text: The subject was seated in the right front passenger seat.
A third occupant, John Doe 2, was in the right rear seat.
claims.explanation: DA letter confirms John Doe 2 was the right rear passenger.

claims.claim_text: John Doe 1 stated he was on AB109 supervision.
The subject had a bag of food on his lap and was using a cell phone.
claims.explanation: DA letter states Montes lifted a bag of food from his lap and placed it on the center console, then started texting. The report implies the food stayed on his lap.

claims.claim_text: I asked the subject to place his hands on the dashboard.
claims.explanation: DA letter quotes Buan saying 'Hey, brother, can you do me a favor, stop reaching around; just put your hands on the front dash.' The report omits the casual language and the reaching behavior that prompted the command.

claims.claim_text: The subject initially complied, then placed his hands on his thighs instead.
claims.explanation: DA letter states Montes did not place his hands on the dash; he put them on his thighs. He never initially complied.

claims.claim_text: The subject reached down on his right side and retrieved a black semi-automatic handgun with his right hand, transferring it quickly to his left hand.
claims.explanation: Consistent with DA letter describing Montes reaching down on his right side, lifting the handgun with right hand, transitioning to left hand.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my firearm six times at the subject.
claims.explanation: Consistent with DA letter: Buan fired six shots.

claims.claim_text: Officer Vega simultaneously discharged his weapon once from the sidewalk position.
claims.explanation: Park was not on the sidewalk at the time of firing. DA letter states Park had just seated John Doe 2 on the curb behind the car. Also, the shots were not exactly simultaneous.

claims.claim_text: A K9 unit was deployed at approximately 1414 hours.
claims.explanation: DA letter states K9 was deployed at 2:14:09 PM which is actually 1414 hours. However the K9 arrived at approximately 2:09 PM, not at 2:14. The report conflates arrival and deployment times.

claims.claim_text: A second extended magazine containing 31 rounds was found during his removal from the vehicle.
claims.explanation: DA letter confirms a second extended magazine with 31 rounds was found during removal from vehicle.
